item.title: South Korea’s president proposes formal end to Korean war talks with North
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung proposed talks with North Korea to formally end the long-running Korean war, as Pyongyang deepens ties with Russia while asserting its status as an “irreversible” nuclear state. The two Koreas remain technically at war because their 1950-53 conflict, triggered by a North Korean attack, ended with an armistice rather than a peace treaty. Lee made the proposal in his speech at a ceremony marking the anniversary of Korea’s liberation from Japan’s 1910–45... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
item.dc:creator: Agence France-Presse

item.title: 'Begin discussions': South Korea's Lee Jae Myung calls for talks with North Korea
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung seeks peace talks to formally end the Korean War. He also wants to discuss North Korea's nuclear capabilities and reduce regional tensions. This proposal comes as North Korea strengthens its military ties with Russia. Annual US-South Korean military exercises are scheduled to begin soon. Lee also addressed improving relations with Japan and fostering prosperity. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Meet the Singaporean DJ taking local sounds to the global stage
item.description: At one of the world’s biggest electronic dance music festivals in Belgium, entranced revellers recently found themselves dancing to sounds more often heard on a Singapore commute than a Tomorrowland stage. They included the MRT warning to “Sila berhati-hati di ruang platform” (“Please mind the platform gap” in Malay), familiar to millions who ride the city state’s metro system, and the piercing, repetitive call of the Asian koel, a bird whose cry is instantly recognisable in many Singapore... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: Picture a fisherman hauling in his nets on a calm morning at sea, when his smartwatch suddenly vibrates with an alert: “Magnetic anomaly detected – possible submarine passing 500 metres below.” Far‑fetched as it sounds, Chinese scientists have just taken a decisive step towards making that scenario real. A team from the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science and the Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology and Engineering, both under the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), has created a Hall‑effect... item.description: Seriousness of remark made in New York on Friday, and whether it signaled new policy ​position, not clear Donald Trump has threatened to declare the strait of Hormuz as “a territory of the United States” as his administration struggles to conclude the war with Iran. During a speech at a police academy on Long Island, New York, on Friday, the US president said he would “pretty soon” designate the waterway – a crucial chokepoint for global trade, through which about a fifth of the world’s seaborne oil supplies typically pass – a US territory. item.title: En El-Obeid, Sudán, mujeres y bebés quedan a merced de los ataques con drones de las FAR
item.description: Las carreteras hacia El-Obeid, en Sudán, están llenas de camiones cisterna destruidos, víctimas de los atroces ataques con drones lanzados por las Fuerzas de Apoyo Rápido (FAR). Este grupo paramilitar libra una guerra civil contra el Ejército sudanés y tiene como objetivo tomar la capital de Kordofán del Norte. Ha estado intentando sitiar la ciudad con ataques que destruyen las instalaciones eléctricas, las principales rutas de abastecimiento y la infraestructura civil, incluidos los hospitales. Los bebés prematuros que se encuentran en incubadoras están a merced de los cortes de energía… Fuente: France 24 - Español.
